req.title: Status code sentence body
req.statement: The system shall include the standard reason phrase in the body when responding to /status/<code> with a code between 400 and 599.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-045 requires that GET /status/<code> for codes 400-599 returns a response whose body contains the standard HTTP reason phrase. The status_code() helper in helpers.py builds the response via make_response() and sets r.status_code; Flask/Werkzeug automatically populates the status line with the reason phrase, and httpbin echoes it in the body for error codes. Tests must: (1) confirm a representative 4xx code body contains the reason phrase (EP positive), (2) confirm a representative 5xx code body contains the reason phrase (EP positive), (3) confirm the boundary code 400 (first 4xx) body contains 'BAD REQUEST' (BVA), (4) confirm the boundary code 599 (last 5xx) body contains a reason phrase (BVA), (5) confirm code 399 (just below range) does NOT produce a 4xx-style body with a reason phrase in the same way (BVA negative), (6) confirm an invalid non-numeric code returns 400 with 'Invalid status code' (NEG), and (7) confirm code 500 body contains 'INTERNAL SERVER ERROR' (DT). All tests use exact assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_status_400_body_contains_reason_phrase
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /status/400 is a valid endpoint
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Capture response status code and body
trace: R-HTTPBIN-045: 400 is in [400,599]; body must contain standard reason phrase 'BAD REQUEST'
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_400_body_contains_reason_phrase():
    r = client.get('/status/400')
    assert r.status_code == 400
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').upper()
    assert 'BAD REQUEST' in body

tests.name: test_status_400_boundary_first_4xx
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
400 is the first code in the 4xx range
actions: Assert exact status code 400 and reason phrase in body
expected: Response status code is exactly 400 (not 399, not 401)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-045 BVA: lower boundary of 4xx range; catches off-by-one mutations on range start
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_400_boundary_first_4xx():
    r = client.get('/status/400')
    assert r.status_code == 400
    assert r.status_code != 399
    assert r.status_code != 401
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').upper()
    assert 'BAD REQUEST' in body

tests.name: test_status_399_below_4xx_range
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
399 is one below the 4xx range
actions: Assert response status code is exactly 399 (not 400)
expected: Body does NOT contain 'BAD REQUEST' (it is a 3xx redirect-class code)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-045 BVA: code just below 400 boundary; distinguishes 399 from 400 to catch boundary mutations
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_399_below_4xx_range():
    r = client.get('/status/399', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 399
    assert r.status_code != 400
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').upper()
    assert 'BAD REQUEST' not in body

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_500_exact_reason_phrase_decision_table():
    r = client.get('/status/500')
    assert r.status_code == 500
    assert r.status_code != 501
    assert r.status_code != 499
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').upper()
    assert 'INTERNAL SERVER ERROR' in body
